title: Little numbers, big discoveries
subject: Mathematics
description: Share mangoes, find patterns, and make sense of division.
body: Division means sharing a group into equal parts. Imagine 12 mangoes and 3 baskets. Put one mango in each basket, again and again. Each basket gets 4 mangoes.
We write this as 12 ÷ 3 = 4. Multiplication checks the answer: 3 × 4 = 12.
Try a larger number: 84 ÷ 4. Share 80 into four groups to get 20, then share the remaining 4 to get 1. Each group gets 21.
If sharing is not exact, there is a remainder. 14 mangoes shared into 3 baskets gives 4 each, with 2 left over.
question: 24 seeds are shared equally into 6 pots. How many seeds go in each pot?
